description_en: Creates and attaches tags to one or more Bastionhost instances
description_zh: 为指定的堡垒机实例统一创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Bastionhost instance resides.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要创建并绑定标签的堡垒机实例的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource.

Set the value to `INSTANCE`. This value indicates a Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型定义。

唯一取值为INSTANCE ，表示堡垒机实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the Bastionhost instances. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs.

N can be from 1 to 20.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the IDs of Bastionhost instances
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机实例ID列表。

N的取值范围为1~20。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.

The tag key cannot be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length.

The tag key cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签键。
N的取值范围：1~20。 

该参数不允许传入空字符串。最多支持传入128个字符。
该参数不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含**http://**或**https://**
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.

The tag value can be an empty string. It can be up to 128 characters in length.

The tag value cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http\:// or https\://
fields.help_zh:
实例的标签值。  
N的取值范围：1~20。
该参数可设置为空字符串，最多支持传入128个字符。
该参数不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含**http://**或者**https://**
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the instances. You can add up to 20 tags
parameters.name: tag

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier that is generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
